goal: Produce a short, well-structured explanation of parallel task execution.

tasks.title: Analyze the benefits
tasks.prompt: List the main benefits of running independent shell tasks in parallel. Keep it to five bullets.

tasks.title: Analyze the risks
tasks.prompt: List the main risks and failure modes of running independent shell tasks in parallel. Keep it to five bullets.
tasks.acceptance: Five concrete risks, including resource contention and hidden failures.

tasks.title: Draft the explanation
tasks.prompt: Combine the benefits and risks into a short explanation suitable for a README. Use the dependency outputs.
tasks.acceptance: A concise draft that mentions both benefits and risks.

tasks.title: Review the draft
tasks.prompt: Review the draft for clarity, unsupported claims, and missing caveats. Return the improved final version.
tasks.acceptance: A final version with no unsupported performance claims.
